info.name: Video Course API - Complete Test Suite
info.description:
Complete test collection for repo-video-course microservice.

Flow: Login → Package → Folder → StudySet → VideoCourse → VideoStep → VideoModule → Progress

All IDs are captured automatically via test scripts.

item.name: 0. Authentication
item.description: Login to get JWT token. Token is saved automatically.

item.name: 1. Package Management
item.description: Manage top-level Packages (e.g. 'Video HSK'). Package contains Folders.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Video HSK",
  "description": "Bộ khóa học video tiếng Hán theo chuẩn HSK",
  "thumbnail": "https://example.com/hsk-thumb.jpg",
  "type": "VIDEO_COURSE",
  "isPrivate": false
}

item.name: 3. StudySet Management
item.description: Manage StudySets inside a Folder (e.g. 'HSK 1 - Bài 1').

item.name: 4. Video Course (Khóa học)
item.description: Manage VideoCourses linked to a StudySet.

item.name: 5. Video Step (Chương học)
item.description: Steps group VideoModules. Steps unlock sequentially — Step 1 is always unlocked, Step N requires Step N-1 completed.

item.name: 03. Get Steps by Course (with unlock status)
6. Video Module (Bài học video)
item.description: VideoModules hold the actual video. Can use videoCode to link a video from repo-multimedia.

item.name: 7. Watch Progress (80% Auto-Complete)
item.description: Track video watching. When watchedSeconds >= 80% of duration, the module auto-completes and cascades to step/course progress.

exec: // The response should reflect module is now COMPLETED

item.name: 8. Available Modules (flashcard/writing/kanji/quiz)
item.description: Admin/Teacher browse available study sets from other repos to associate with video steps.

item.name: 9. Available Videos (từ repo-multimedia)
item.description: Admin/Teacher browse videos from repo-multimedia to embed in VideoModules.

item.name: 10. Full Test Flow (Sequential Unlock Demo)
item.description: Demonstrates the full flow: Step 2 is LOCKED until Step 1 is 100% completed (via 80% auto-complete). VIDEO CODE must be set first.

item.name: Step 3: Verify Step 2 is now UNLOCKED
11. Cleanup (Delete)
item.description: Run these LAST to clean up test data.
